recovery.export_strategy: Hardlink identical immutable graph bundle after proving final checkpoint equality; strictly load each final checkpoint into a fresh exported model before execution
recovery.interruption: Disk guard stopped final export after step-30 checkpoint; preserved original guard journal

import gc,hashlib,json,os,shutil
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from safetensors.torch import load_file
from examples.huggingface.decoder_sft import OnnxDecoder
from examples.huggingface.replay import _equal_tree
from examples.lora.mlx_runtime import register_library,session
root=Path('/tmp/onnax-gated-qualified-sft');resumed=Path('/tmp/onnax-gated-qualified-resume')

# Completed parameter/state equality was checked before restoring this bundle.
first=load_file(root/'checkpoint-30/model.safetensors');second=load_file(resumed/'checkpoint-30/model.safetensors')
_equal_tree(first,second)
for name in ('optimizer.pt','scheduler.pt'):
 _equal_tree(torch.load(root/'checkpoint-30'/name,weights_only=True),torch.load(resumed/'checkpoint-30'/name,weights_only=True))
if not (resumed/'export').exists():shutil.copytree(root/'export',resumed/'export',copy_function=os.link)
files=[p for p in (root/'export').rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
assert all(p.stat().st_ino==(resumed/'export'/p.relative_to(root/'export')).stat().st_ino for p in files)
register_library('/tmp/onnax-gated-test-runtime/libonnxruntime_mlx_ep.dylib')
torch.set_num_threads(1)
ids=torch.tensor([[1,4,5,6,7,8,9,2]],dtype=torch.int64)
feed={'input_ids':ids,'attention_mask':torch.ones_like(ids),'position_ids':torch.arange(8)[None],'labels':ids.clone()}
results=[]
for directory,state in ((root,first),(resumed,second)):
 model=OnnxDecoder.load(directory/'export',session_factory=session)
 model.load_state_dict(state,strict=True)
 output=model(**feed);output.loss.backward()
 values={'logits':output.logits.detach().numpy().copy(),'loss':output.loss.detach().numpy().copy()}
 values.update({name:p.grad.detach().numpy().copy() for name,p in model.onnx.parameters_by_name().items()})
 assert all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in values.values())
 results.append(values)
 model.close();del model,output;gc.collect()
assert results[0].keys()==results[1].keys()
for name in results[0]:
 a,b=results[0][name],results[1][name]
 assert a.dtype==b.dtype and a.shape==b.shape and a.tobytes()==b.tobytes(),name
report={'checkpoint_state_tensors':len(first),'checkpoint_and_adamw_scheduler_byte_identical':True,'completed_step':30,'restored_from_step':15,'loaded_logits_loss_and_adapter_gradients_byte_identical':True,'adapter_gradients':len(results[0])-2,'restored_graph_files':len(files),'export_strategy':'Hardlink identical immutable graph bundle after proving final checkpoint equality; strictly load each final checkpoint into a fresh exported model before execution','interruption':'Disk guard stopped final export after step-30 checkpoint; preserved original guard journal','output_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256(value.tobytes()).hexdigest() for name,value in results[0].items()}}
Path('/tmp/onnax-gated-qualified-recovery.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report))
